test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Khush Mahal within the walls of Warangal Fort, was built in which of the following dynasties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tughlaq.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• During the **reign of Tughlak**, the** Khush Mahal **is claimed to have been built on the location of the **Kakatiya palace.**
 
• It was constructed in the** 14th century **as an **audience hall.**
 
• The fort has **four ornamental gates** known as **Kakatiya Kala Thoranam,** which were once the entrances to a now-destroyed huge **Shiva temple.**
 
• Following the bifurcation of Andhra Pradesh, the **Kakatiyan arch** was accepted and officially included in **Telangana's insignia.**
 
• On **September 10, 2010**, the Permanent Delegation of India to UNESCO submitted the fort to the "tentative list" of** UNESCO World Heritage Sites.**
 
• **Tughlaqs:**
 
 
• The Tughlaqs were a **Turkic-speaking Muslim family.**
 
• Between **AD 1330 and 1335**, when **Muhammad Bin Tughlaq** launched a military campaign, the dynasty achieved its pinnacle.
 
• The **founder **of the Tughlaq dynasty is **Ghiyas-ud-Din-Tughlaq.**
 
• **Nasir-ud-Din Mahmud Shah Tughluq** also known as Nasiruddin Mohammad Shah, was the** last sultan** of the Tughlaq dynasty to rule the **Islamic Delhi Sultanate.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Lodi dynasty__:**

 __
 
• The Lodi dynasty was an** Afghan dynasty** that ruled the **Delhi Sultanate** from **1451 to 1526.**
 
• It was the** fifth and final dynasty** of the Delhi Sultanate and was** founded** by** Bahlul Khan Lodi **when he replaced the Sayyid dynasty.
 
• In the** First Battle of Panipat **in **1526 CE,** **Babur defeated** Ibrahim Lodi, the final prince of the Lodi dynasty.
 
• The Lodi dynasty, as well as the Delhi Sultanate, came to an end in this battle.
 
 
 
• **Chola Dynasty__:**
 __
 
• The Chola Dynasty was a **Tamil thalassocratic empire** in southern India, and it was one of the **world's longest-ruling empires.**
 
• **Vijayalaya**, the first feudatory of the **Pallavas of Kanchi**, founded the Chola Empire.
 
• In the year **850 A.D.**, he conquered **Tanjore**. He built a temple dedicated to the goddess **Nishumbhasudini (Durga)** there.
 
• **Aditya I **was** victorious** over Vijayalaya.
 
• The conquest of the Chola empire by the **Pandyas in 1257** resulted in the** end **of the Chola empire in **1279.**
 
 
 
• **Khilji Dynasty**__**:**
 
 
• The Khalji or Khilji dynasty was a **Turco-Afghan dynasty** that ruled over the Delhi Sultanate for about** three decades, from 1290 to 1320.**
 
• This is the **second dynasty** to reign the Delhi Sultanate of India,** founded** by **Jalal ud din Firuz Khalji.**
 
• **Malik Kafur** was **assassinated** by **Mubarak Khan**, Shihab-ud-older din's brother, who eventually deposed Shihab-ud-din and became the king of the Khilji Dynasty. **In 1320**, Mubarak Khan's officer** Khusrav Khan** assassinated him and other Khilji family members, putting an **end** to the Khilji Dynasty.
